description:
The 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade (CIFIT) concluded in east China's coastal city Xiamen on Friday, attracting delegations from 129 countries and regions.
What does CIFIT mean to officials from around the world? Representatives from the United Kingdom, Ghana and the Philippines share why they came to CIFIT, how the event helps connect countries and businesses, and how they view China's continued opening-up and growing opportunities in trade, investment, green development and technology.
Check it out.
